B-803 End-to-End Walkthrough

On this page

B-803 MVP end-to-end walkthrough (mission brief §Success criteria) ​

Dependency: run this on one Windows machine only after B-801..802 and B-805 are code-complete (CI green). Success criteria (mission brief §MVP): auto-start on boot → see the state in a corner of the desktop at all times → a one-click Run/Retry succeeds, all without opening a browser or signing in to GitHub. The invariant items in detail are in acceptance-B705-L0-behavior.en.md (its 5 real-machine checklist items are ticked off inside B-803). Output: recorded screenshots/archive plus either a fix or an issue for anything found; B-804 additionally needs a clean Win11 VM on top of this.

0. Preparation (5 minutes) ​

  • [ ] Download beacon-nightly-windows-x86_64-setup.exe (or the portable zip) and verify SHA256SUMS
  • [ ] Start screen recording (continuous for the whole run; take separate screenshots of problem points)
  • [ ] A machine with GitHub repository access plus one PAT (used for connection entry and Retry)
  • [ ] A controllable workflow ready (can be failed on demand and re-run, for example a test workflow in the repository)

1. Script main chain (each link of the mission brief success criteria) ​

#StepActionPass criteriaResult
1Install / extractRun setup.exe (or extract the zip)No errors; Beacon appears in the Start menu (the zip route shows a Beacon.App.exe icon directly)☐
2First-launch feedbackStart BeaconStartup notification bubble + tray icon + status capsule in the bottom-right corner; no main window, and it does not enter the taskbar/Alt-Tab☐
3Auto-start on bootCheck HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunA Beacon entry pointing at the install path (can be turned off in settings)☐
4Enter a connectionTray menu → Settings → Connections → type github → fill in Id + Token"✓ 已保存"; the connection test returns Healthy☐
5Token red lineOpen %AppData%\Beacon\connections.json and search the whole file for the PAT itselfThe plaintext token is not found, only credentialRef☐
6Add widgetsSettings → Widgets: github.actions.runs + github.pull_requests (pick a connection, fill the required fields)Two entries appear in the list; the L2 panel shows the corresponding rows and counts☐
7Pin to the desktopTurn on the "钉" switch on the widget rowA tile appears on L0 (status light + label)☐
8Cause a failureFail the controllable workflow onceThe capsule turns red / the count changes + the tray icon is recolored + a Toast pops up (with sound per the rule)☐
9Drill into the detailClick the Toast (or the L2 row) to enter L3The detail window shows status/repository/phase/error summary; L0 is not interrupted☐
10One-click RetryClick [Retry] in L3 (no browser opened at any point)The workflow re-runs successfully → Success Toast + the light turns green☐
11Settings immediacyChange a severity color / motion tier / opacity / capsule toggleTakes effect immediately (a theme change taking effect on restart is expected); still in force after a restart☐
12Import / exportSettings → export the configuration; then import it after breaking thingsBehaviour is restored; the exported file contains no token; it prompts to re-enter the secret☐
13Offline degradationDisconnect the networkThe tile shows a gray hollow light + Last update; no exception dialog; resets automatically on recovery☐

2. Four interaction levels checklist (RFC §6) ​

  • [ ] An L0 tile single click → L2 opens and takes focus; ESC closes it; it closes automatically on focus loss
  • [ ] An L2 row single click → L3 detail; closing L3 returns to the always-resident L0
  • [ ] Hovering, dragging, and collapsing/expanding L0 never activates the window and never interrupts the current input focus
  • [ ] Every tray menu entry works (panel / settings / notifications / refresh / exit); the hotkey Ctrl+Alt+B summons the panel
  • [ ] All 5 items of the B-705 invariant real-machine checklist are ticked (see that document)

3. GLM quota end to end (blocking acceptance feedback: connect the source → add a widget → real numbers on the board) ​

#StepActionPass criteriaResult
G1Enter the GLM connectionSettings → Connections → type bigmodel → Id + PAT (or a raw key)The connection test returns Healthy; it suggests "在下方组件向导选该连接，或用『一键添加』即可上板"☐
G2One-click exampleSettings → bigmodel module → "一键添加 GLM 额度组件（示例）"bigmodel.usage:GLM appears in the widget list; Pinned=true pins it automatically; the L0 capsule in the bottom-right corner shows a value card + progress bar☐
G3First number on screenWait ≤10 s (the CI/Ci tier)The capsule shows "GLM 额度 · 已用 XX% · 剩 YY tokens · MM-DD HH:MM 重置"; the progress bar fills according to the used percentage; right-clicking the L2 row shows a Source: GLM annotation☐
G4Field mapping self-checkSettings → widget bigmodel.usage:GLM → edit → confirm the total_path/used_path/reset_path mapping is correctThe field paths match the GLM quota/limit response shape ($.data.total / $.data.used / $.data.reset_at)☐
G5Forced manual refreshTray menu → Refresh AllThe value and progress bar refresh live; the log %APPDATA%\Beacon\logs\beacon-*.log has one line per hop (one-click add → fetch → field mapping → render)☐

⚠️ Screenshots must be produced on a real Windows machine (Linux can only run unit tests / builds; WinUI 3 does not run in that environment). After finishing G1–G5, capture one screenshot of the L0 capsule and one of the L2 panel, save them to docs/img/, and attach them to the PR or reply.

4. Archive ​

  • [ ] Save recordings and screenshots to docs/img/ (large recordings may go into a Release asset with a link from the README)
  • [ ] For every failed item: fix it on the spot (through the gate, pushed) or file an issue
  • [ ] B-804: run the same script once on a clean Win11 VM (download → run → this checklist), recording first-install environment behaviour such as VC++ and SmartScreen
